source: Retained Baofeng Mini 5 BT CPS - Unofficial build 18

reviews.scope: Audit remediation stage 1, authorized by maintainer to begin fixes. DAT parsing limits and encoder comments only; radio encoding logic, transport, commands and map unchanged.

Maintainer-authorized F02 decoder correction using reported hardware evidence at 0x900C, 0x900B and 0x801B. Preserve direct byte values, including matching VFO B squelch storage; reject unknown values through unchanged writer validation. No encoder, transport or connection-reset changes.

F07 format-loss containment: decode valid 100.00000–999.99999 channel BCD without the unsupported 600 MHz cutoff; reject malformed/out-of-format values and keep complete failed-read diagnostics. Add preflight channel-format validation before connection. No encoder, frame, command, acknowledgement, disconnect or reset changes. Hardware frequency capability remains unverified.

Maintainer-authorized F07 channel input policy from recorded factory-CPS ranges and 1.25 kHz grid. Shared edit/preflight validation only; unchanged imported/read values remain exportable. No normalization, VFO rule change, encoding, frame, command, ACK, disconnect/reset or transaction-method changes.

F05 master-task authorization: validate complete existing identification replies and bind upload to device/characteristic/generation. Guards only; unchanged handshake commands, frames, ACK semantics, readback, no-retry, disconnect/reset.

F08 correction explicitly approved by K4RJM for UAT then LIVE on October 17. Factory trailing-buffer pattern corroborated by independent full-image captures. Replaces final-pair rejection with unsupported-record-1000 rejection. Writer change only refreshes encoder module URL; transaction methods unchanged. No new physical-radio write performed in this release session.
